skill_name: Write an article introducing the city of Paris.
workflow: Paris, the city of love, has been a major tourist destination for centuries. Known for its stunning architecture, amazing food, and rich culture, Paris is visited by millions of travellers each year. The Eiffel Tower remains the iconic centrepiece of the city, but its beauty goes far beyond this iconic landmark.
